name: Your system, after 2 PM
rules: Uses your screener on coins: last night's setups (Momentum and Pullback), in the coin table's order. Last night = the screener run after the day's bar closed at midnight UTC (7 PM Central in winter, 8 PM in summer).

Holds 2 positions at a time, and never spends more than 30% of the account on one buy. Buys only after 2:00 PM Central (3:00 PM New York), at the first check after that, using the same setups as Your system. Sells on the same signals: the trend check at about 10:00 New York time, then the stop every 30 minutes until 5:45 PM New York time.

Buys the coin itself. The stock version buys a call by your option rules (15-30 days out, delta 0.50-0.80, open interest over 500); coins have no options a normal brokerage account can buy, so it does what the stock version does when no call fits: buys the top setup outright.
Takes the first of the top 15 setups that passes the checks when it buys, and skips a setup that has dropped below its 50-day EMA by then.

Your overbought rule: it doesn't buy anything with RSI over 70 or CCI over 100 (checked on the live price when it buys), or while the market's breadth or the coin's category's is over the 75 line (the share of its coins with the 10 EMA over the 20, last night).
Sells if the coin drops 8% or after a daily close below the 50-day EMA or 150-day average (the stock accounts' exits for shares).
The exits are my defaults, since your screener doesn't set any. Tell me yours and I'll switch.
fills: Paper trades, no real money. Coins fill at Yahoo's latest 1-minute price, 0.05% worse, and fractions of a coin are allowed. No exchange fee is charged; real exchanges charge about 0.1% to 0.6% a trade.

log.text: Trial started with $1,000.00. It runs to Apr 6, 2027.
